entities.summary: The University of Austin (UATX) is an unaccredited private liberal arts university located in Austin, Texas, United States. The university established a campus in Downtown Austin's Scarbrough Building, enrolled its first undergraduate cohort in the fall of 2024. It is certified by the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board to award degrees and was granted "candidate for accreditation" status by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education in 2025. UATX does not charge tuition or accept government funding.
